notes:
Ronin TV 2.1.4
- Home, Movies and Shows redesigned: fullscreen backdrop cycling the TMDB Top 10, with your category rows underneath
- Live TV guide redesigned: preview screen top-left, guide underneath
- Hold Back in the guide to take the preview channel straight to fullscreen
- New Trailer button beside Play — trailers now play fullscreen; the mini trailer player is gone
- Favourite folders: organise favourite channels into folders
- Hold a channel for favourite and add-to-folder options
- Hold a category to hide it, create a folder, or place the whole category in a folder
- Fixed: hold menus not opening with the remote
- Fixed: Back from fullscreen lands on the channel you were watching
- Fixed: delay when returning from fullscreen to the guide
- Fixed: constant crashing
- Series tabs now file shows by their real production network — most watched first, top 100 per tab
- Continue Watching split: movies in Movies, shows in Series; adult titles never appear there
- Adult categories show like any other: hold to hide, unhide in Settings → Channels
